Digital & Research Office Secretariat

Directorate of Information Technology (IT)

The Directorate of Information Technology (IT) powers the digital ecosystem of the University of Loralai. The directorate manages the campus-wide fiber optic network backbone, PERN (Pakistan Education & Research Network) internet bandwidth, student DIMS portals, university web portals, surveillance systems, and high-performance computer laboratories.

Statutory Scope

Core Functions & Operational Responsibilities

  • Administering the Digital Information Management System (DIMS) portal for students and faculty.
  • Managing PERN high-speed gigabit fiber connectivity and campus Wi-Fi access points.
  • Provisioning official `@uoli.edu.pk` G-Suite email accounts for staff and enrolled students.
  • Maintaining university web server infrastructure, cybersecurity firewall, and database backups.
  • Upgrading hardware facilities across 5 state-of-the-art computer science and IT laboratories.
